title: Retaining wall beneath a boundary wall is included in the wall height
text: C3.4.4 Boundary walls may be built in accordance with Table 3.4c provided: i. boundary walls are located behind the street setback; ii. overshadowing does not exceed the limits of C3.8.1; and iii. they are finished to an equivalent standard to the rest of the development, to the satisfaction of the decision-maker. Table 3.4c note: Where a boundary wall incorporates a retaining wall directly beneath the boundary wall, the retaining wall does not require assessment under C3.5.1 and is to be included in the wall height for the purposes of C3.4.5 (refer Figure 3.4k).

replaces.note: exception for retaining walls approved through the subdivision plan dropped

verified.note: Printed as 'for the purposes of C3.4.5'; the heights are set in C3.4.4/Table 3.4c, likely a cross-reference slip. Encoding unaffected.

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.4#r2. Table 3.4c note; building.boundary_walls.max_height_m already includes the retaining wall beneath. Cross-reference slips as in Chapter 3: 'C3.5.1' (retaining walls) and 'for the purposes of C3.4.5' (should be C3.4.4; C4P1-095).
